subject.title: fix(feishu): cancel agent runs when source messages are recalled

question: Should OpenClaw accept this Feishu-local source-message recall cancellation path before defining the shared cross-channel edit/delete/recall lifecycle contract in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/55691?
rationale: The implementation stays inside the Feishu plugin, but it changes run/session cancellation and reply-delivery semantics for a behavior that the canonical issue still frames as a cross-channel product/API decision.

options.title: Accept Feishu slice after proof
options.body: Land this bounded plugin-local path once live Feishu/Lark proof covers pending, active, and reply-suppression behavior, and keep the umbrella issue open for shared semantics.

options.title: Require shared lifecycle first
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers define a source-message edit/delete/recall contract and then adapt Feishu to that shared contract.

options.title: Keep as draft implementation candidate
options.body: Leave the PR open but require a smaller proof-positive Feishu run before choosing the architecture boundary.

recommendation.title: Accept Feishu slice after proof
recommendation.body: Land this bounded plugin-local path once live Feishu/Lark proof covers pending, active, and reply-suppression behavior, and keep the umbrella issue open for shared semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent history on the Feishu runtime/debounce/dispatch files touched by the PR and is the best available owner for the channel-local boundary choice.
